title: Raw Imagery Impacting Your AI: Should You Care?

problem.summary: Onboard AI is gaining interest for space applications such as vessel, wildfire, and cloud detection, where real-time processing can improve mission reactivity and reduce downlink needs.

This study evaluates how image degradation affects object detection by varying Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR), Modulation Transfer Function (MTF) at Nyquist, and Ground Sampling Distance (GSD).
Controlled degradations are applied to Very High Resolution Maxar imagery, and three lightweight detectors, YOLOv5s, YOLOX-S, and NanoDet, are evaluated on the resulting operating points.
